question: What is the meaning of product usage history in relation to reuse?
description: Product usage history in relation to reuse refers to the detailed record of how a product has been utilized throughout its operational life. This information is crucial for assessing the viability of reusing a product, as it provides insights into the patterns of usage and the conditions the product has been subjected to over time. Understanding the product usage history helps in determining the suitability of a product for reuse, guiding decisions on whether refurbishment is necessary and supporting efforts to extend the product's life cycle effectively.

3.1. Benefits of DPPs for reuse strategies
DPPs are emerging as a transformative tool for enhancing CE stra­
tegies, particularly in identifying and facilitating reuse opportunities. 
DPP platforms can offer a comprehensive life cycle data overview, which 
is fundamental for determining products suitable for reuse (Alcayaga 
et al., 2019). By leveraging the capabilities of Internet-of-Things tech­
nologies, DPPs can facilitate the recording of product usage history, 
ensuring detailed tracking throughout the product’s life cycle (Gligoric 
et al., 2019). This level of detail enables the capture of usage patterns 
and conditions over time, which is important in assessing a product’s 
viability for reuse. Moreover, DPPs extend their utility by providing 
monitoring capabilities for product conditions and usage patterns. Such 
functionalities are essential for timely assessing the viability of reuse, 
allowing for a dynamic response to the changing state of products 
(Alamerew and Brissaud, 2019; Gligoric et al., 2019). They act as re­
positories for vital information, encompassing many aspects of a prod­
uct’s life cycle and reuse potential. This knowledge base supports 
stakeholders in understanding the circular capabilities of products, thus 
facilitating the transition toward sustainable practices (King et al., 
2023). DPP plays a role in preserving the value of products through 
extended life cycles. By enabling a more precise and informed approach 
to reuse, DPPs demonstrate the tangible benefits of integrating CE 
strategies into mainstream production and consumption patterns 
(Berger et al., 2023b; Walden et al., 2021). Furthermore, the insights 
provided by DPPs empower stakeholders to make informed decisions 
regarding the feasibility and implementation of reuse strategies. These 
insights not only enhance the efficiency of resource utilization but also 
promote the adoption of sustainable practices across industries, high­
lighting the role of DPPs in advancing sustainable production and con­
sumption (Reich et al., 2023).

product-related data points to support effective reuse strategies, which 
are essential for extending product life cycles, minimizing waste, and 
reducing environmental impacts. Insights into how products have been 
used during their operational life provide information for identifying 
products suitable for reuse, thus contributing to waste reduction and 
resource efficiency (de Oliveira and Soares, 2017). The physical state of 
products is essential for determining the feasibility of their reuse and the 
extent of refurbishment required, highlighting the importance of prod­
